definitions: An environment or context in which something develops; a surrounding medium or structure.
A mould into which molten metal, plastic, or other material is introduced to give it a particular shape.
A rectangular array of quantities or expressions, arranged in rows and columns, that is treated as a single entity and manipulated according to particular rules.
The intercellular substance of a tissue.
examples: The matrix of the problem was complex.
The matrix for the plastic toy was custom-made.
He performed calculations using a 3x3 matrix.
The bone matrix provides structural support.
